issues.on_page: Capital outlay 6,500 (Park column; no function printed on the row)
issues.issue: The function in the label comes from the department column and the category name, not from a printed function (p9 prints 'Environment and leisure'). Same for detail[38] (Library 6,182, 'Capital Outlay: Culture/Recreation') and detail[48] (Street Fund 23,197, 'Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways'; the statement function is 'Public works'). These are marked computed, but the capital outlay rule says to add a function only when it is printed.
It is very likely highway allocation, but the page does not say so (assumption).

issues.on_page: Contributions and grants 14,546 (SoA p2: Operating Grants and Contributions)
issues.issue: Mixed grants and contributions label with no breakdown by grantor. It is kept as one line under the 2026-11-06 ruling, but grants and donations are separate categories, so the category is a judgment call (review present). Same for detail[6], [8] and [13].
The line combines salaries with payroll taxes and benefits, so it could also be employee benefits and payroll taxes. Same for detail[24] and detail[31].
